eval: (async()=>{ const b=window.__bn; window.__NODET=true; const C=b.AU.ctx; const an=C.createAnalyser(); an.fftSize=2048; b.AU.out.connect(an); const buf=new Float32Array(2048); const pk=async(ms)=>{ let p=0; const t0=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t0<ms){ an.getFloatTimeDomainData(buf); for(const v of buf) p=Math.max(p,Math.abs(v)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,30)); } return +p.toFixed(3); }; const out=[['title', b.MUS.curName, await pk(2500)]]; await b.startChapter('kitchen'); for(let i=0;i<120 && b.state!=='play';i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); const t1=performance.now(); while(b.MUS.curName!=='sneak' && performance.now()-t1<15000) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); out.push(['kitchen', b.state, b.LEVEL, b.MUS.curName, Math.round(performance.now()-t1), await pk(2500)]); const t2=performance.now(); while(performance.now()-t2<3000){ b.meter=.9; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); } out.push(['seen', +b.MUS.ten.toFixed(2), await pk(1500)]); b.meter=0; b.pauseNow(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); out.push(['paused', +b.MUS.duck.toFixed(2), +b.MUS.bus.gain.value.toFixed(3)]); return out; })()
